CustomField.description: Visual actor context derived from delegated access, effective actor and deployment-user fields.
CustomField.formula: IF(Is_Delegated_Access__c, IF(ISBLANK(Effective_Actor__c), "⚠️ Login-As Actor Unresolved", "🔑 Login-As Access"), IF(ISBLANK(Effective_Actor__c), "⚠️ Actor Unresolved", IF(Deployment_User_Log__c, "🚀 Deployment User", "👤 Internal User")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows whether the effective actor was delegated, a deployment user or unresolved.
CustomField.label: Actor Context
